```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import csv, html, collections, datetime

def rd(path):
    try:
        with open(path, newline='', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
            return [{(k or '').strip(): (v or '').strip()
                     for k, v in r.items() if k} for r in csv.DictReader(fh)]
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return []

def num(s):
    try:    return float(s)
    except (TypeError, ValueError): return None

def dstr(s):
    try:    return datetime.date.fromisoformat(s).strftime('%a %d %b %Y')
    except Exception: return s or '—'

E = html.escape
log = [r for r in rd('wear_log.csv') if r.get('name')]
cat = {r['name']: r for r in rd('fragrances.csv') if r.get('name')}

groups = collections.OrderedDict()
for r in log:
    groups.setdefault((r['name'], r.get('maker', '')), []).append(r)
for k in groups:
    groups[k].sort(key=lambda r: (r.get('date', ''), r.get('ts', '')), reverse=True)
groups = collections.OrderedDict(
    sorted(groups.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1][0].get('date', ''), reverse=True))

out = []
out.append('<div class="wj-wrap">')
out.append('<header class="wj-hero"><h1>Wear Journal</h1>'
           '<p>Personal observations · one row per wear</p>'
           '<a class="wj-back" href="index.html">← Back to the selector</a></header>')

if not log:
    out.append('<div class="wj-none">No wears logged yet. Mark a fragrance as worn '
               'on the selector, then download and commit <code>wear_log.csv</code>.</div>')
else:
    dates = sorted(r.get('date', '') for r in log if r.get('date'))
    out.append('<div class="wj-sum">')
    for big, small in [(str(len(log)), 'wears logged'),
                       (str(len(groups)), 'fragrances worn'),
                       (dstr(dates[0]), 'first entry'),
                       (dstr(dates[-1]), 'latest entry')]:
        out.append('<div class="wj-stat"><strong>' + E(big) + '</strong><small>'
                   + E(small) + '</small></div>')
    out.append('</div>')

    for (name, maker), wears in groups.items():
        claimed = cat.get(name, {})
        rt = [num(w.get('rating_today', '')) for w in wears]
        rt = [x for x in rt if x is not None]
        lo = [num(w.get('longevity_obs_h', '')) for w in wears]
        lo = [x for x in lo if x is not None]

        out.append('<div class="wj-card">')
        out.append('<h2>' + E(name) + '</h2>')
        out.append('<div class="wj-maker">' + E(maker) + '</div>')

        out.append('<div class="wj-obs">')
        out.append('<span class="wj-badge">' + str(len(wears)) + ' wear'
                   + ('' if len(wears) == 1 else 's') + '</span>')
        if rt:
            out.append('<span class="wj-badge">your avg '
                       + str(round(sum(rt)/len(rt), 1)) + ' / 5</span>')
        if lo:
            obs = sum(lo)/len(lo)
            out.append('<span class="wj-badge">obs '
                       + str(round(obs, 1)) + ' h</span>')
            cl = num(claimed.get('longevity_hours', ''))
            if cl:
                d = obs - cl
                cls = 'hi' if d > 0.5 else ('lo' if d < -0.5 else '')
                out.append('<span class="wj-badge ' + cls + '">vs claimed '
                           + ('%+.1f' % d) + ' h</span>')
        cw = num(claimed.get('overall_rating', ''))
        if cw:
            out.append('<span class="wj-badge">crowd '
                       + str(round(cw, 1)) + '</span>')
        out.append('</div>')

        for w in wears:
            facts = []
            if w.get('occasion'): facts.append(E(w['occasion']))
            if w.get('sprays'):   facts.append(E(w['sprays']) + ' sprays')
            if w.get('temp_f'):   facts.append(E(w['temp_f']) + '°F')
            if w.get('weather'):  facts.append(E(w['weather']))
            if w.get('rating_today'): facts.append('rated ' + E(w['rating_today']))
            if w.get('longevity_obs_h'): facts.append(E(w['longevity_obs_h']) + ' h')
            out.append('<div class="wj-entry">')
            out.append('<div class="wj-date">' + E(dstr(w.get('date', ''))) + '</div>')
            if facts:
                out.append('<div class="wj-facts">' + ' · '.join(facts) + '</div>')
            n = (w.get('notes') or '').strip()
            if n:
                out.append('<div class="wj-notes">' + E(n) + '</div>')
            out.append('</div>')

        out.append('</div>')      # closes wj-card

    out.append('</div>')          # ← closes wj-wrap

print(''.join(out))
```

.wj-empty{ color:var(--muted); font-style:italic; }

</style>
